content.value_statement: Obsidian Web Clipper templates can be hard to build when selectors, properties, and note formats must match. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through validated template design for Obsidian vault workflows.
actual_capabilities: Creates import-ready Obsidian Web Clipper template drafts.
Maps Obsidian Bases properties to Clipper properties.
Chooses variables from presets, meta tags, selectors, and Schema.org data.
Applies filters for Markdown conversion, dates, lists, and filenames.
Uses reference pages to verify selectors before final output.
Provides recipe and general clipping examples.
limitations: Requires a representative URL or DOM snapshot for selector-specific templates.
Cannot guarantee that websites keep the same markup over time.
Requires user review before importing templates into Obsidian.
Does not manage vault files unless the user provides access.

use_cases.title: Build Research Clipping Templates
use_cases.description: Create templates that save article content, source URLs, authors, and published dates into structured Obsidian notes.

use_cases.title: Convert Recipe Pages
use_cases.description: Use Schema.org recipe data to capture ingredients, instructions, nutrition, and source metadata.

use_cases.title: Align Clips With Bases
use_cases.description: Map an existing Obsidian Base schema to Web Clipper properties for consistent frontmatter.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner template for general article clipping.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Obsidian Web Clipper template for general articles. Include title, content, author, source URL, published date, and description.

prompt_templates.title: Build From a Sample Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow using a representative URL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Web Clipper template for this sample page: [URL]. Verify available meta tags, Schema.org data, and selectors before choosing variables.

prompt_templates.title: Match an Obsidian Base
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured vault workflow with existing Base properties.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read my Obsidian Base properties and create a matching Web Clipper template. Explain which properties are automatic, fixed, or manual.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Specialized Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced template for a specific content type.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a robust Web Clipper template for [content type]. Use Schema.org first, fallback to meta tags, and only use verified CSS selectors.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a general article clipping template.
output_examples.output: A template plan with article content, title-based file naming, source metadata, author, published date, and a Clippings destination.

output_examples.input: A user provides a recipe page with Schema.org recipe data.
output_examples.output: A recipe template outline that captures ingredients, instructions, image, cuisine, nutrition, author, and source URL.

output_examples.input: A user has an Obsidian Base for research notes.
output_examples.output: A property mapping that aligns Base fields with Web Clipper variables and marks uncertain fields for manual review.

best_practices: Verify selectors against a real page before using them.
Prefer Schema.org and meta variables before fragile CSS selectors.
Review generated templates in Obsidian before regular use.
anti_patterns: Guessing selectors without checking the target page.
Using long class chains that may break after site updates.
Hardcoding vault paths or properties without confirming the user's Base.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates Obsidian Web Clipper template drafts that users can review and import.

faq.question: Can it use my existing Obsidian Bases?
faq.answer: Yes. It can map Base properties to Web Clipper properties when you provide the Base file or schema.

faq.question: Does it need a sample URL?
faq.answer: A sample URL is recommended when the template needs selectors or site-specific fields.

faq.question: Can it create recipe templates?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes guidance and examples for Schema.org Recipe fields.

faq.question: Will generated selectors always keep working?
faq.answer: No. Website markup can change, so selectors should be tested and maintained.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
